sites.name: Gmail (Google)
sites.evidence_note: Draft from provider help; account type, browser, plan, wording and live flow require review. Unknown is not a claim of absence.

sources.scope: Physical FIDO2 passkey and security-key second step; seven-day delay possible.

steps.text: Sign in to your Google Account and open Security.

image.alt: Sign in to your Google Account and open Security.

steps.text: Open Passkeys and security keys, then choose to create a passkey.

image.alt: Open Passkeys and security keys, then choose to create a passkey.

steps.text: Register your spare separately, naming each key if offered.
